meta.kind: brand wordmark (not an icon, not a component)
meta.status: ASSET PRESENT, IN USE — no registry gate currently covers this asset class
meta.$comment_status: The owner pasted the mark into chat; no available tool extracts a pasted image's raw bytes to disk (same gap logged for the 3D icons on 2026-08-14), so it was located instead at the file the owner had already saved it to on this machine — Downloads/Noma/Noma Logo 2.png — verified pixel-identical to what was pasted before use. A second export, 'Noma Logo.png' (14000x8000, flattened to white, no alpha), was supplied alongside it and is NOT used: same mark, no transparency, print-resolution rather than a UI asset.
meta.$comment_crop: Source canvas is 1500x1500 with the mark occupying a 1061x192 region. Cropped to that content box plus 6% horizontal / 30% vertical padding (wordmarks want air around the x-height, not a tight box) — see build_wordmark_assets() note in build-auth.py for the exact numbers if this needs re-deriving from a replacement file.

assets.label: NOMA wordmark
usedFor: Sign-in splash (full-bleed, before the sheet arrives)
Sign-in sheet header (small, above the tagline)
assets.note: All-caps grotesque sans, black, no icon or symbol. Transparent background — safe on any ground from white through the sheet's own gradient to a photograph.
renderedAt: docs/features/first-run/auth-prototype.html — splash (96px wide) and login sheet (72px wide)

assets.label: Master key card
usedFor: Node 4 · Setup profile — the profile card and the home key
assets.note: Owner-supplied artwork, used AS THE BASE and written over. The bevel, grain, rule and key glyph are all in the image; nothing in code redraws them. Only four things sit on top and all four are live: the avatar, the serif initial, the name and the email.
assets.$comment_web: WebP quality 72 at 640px, not the usual 92. The artwork is a soft gradient plus film grain, and grain is the most expensive thing a lossy codec can encode — q92 came to 388 KB for an asset that renders at 244pt. 138 KB is still ~2.6x the rendered size.

assets.label: Resident's key
usedFor: Node 18a · the key sent to a household member
assets.note: Owner-supplied artwork, used AS IS — no name, no initials, no avatar, nothing live on it. The master key (node 4) is personal; this one is deliberately generic, which is what makes it sendable. Replaced the composited member card.
